title: Nixon sets up Operation 40 after Castro refuses his terms

tellings.quote: And so he then set up this covert operation, which was called originally operation 40.

plain: Around 1959, after Fidel Castro, the new revolutionary leader of Cuba, refused his terms, Richard Nixon, then Vice President, is said to have set up a secret operation first called Operation 40. The lawyer Dan Sheehan tells this without naming a source and links it to the mob boss Santo Trafficante Jr. He tells it as the start of a covert group he connects to later events, including the killing of President John F. Kennedy.
